result.reason: The clause otherwise tracks the fallback by making the restriction mutual, limiting it to personnel directly involved in the services, retaining the general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and imposing no no-hire. However, retaining “During the Term” means a former participant may remain protected for the entire remaining Term, even after 12 months have elapsed since their involvement ended. The restriction should instead apply during the individual’s involvement and for 12 months thereafter. The drafting also retains avoidable defects such as “and/or” and “For purpose of this Article.”
